facts.text: Gina said she was glad to help Jon and mentioned she would always be there to cheer him on.

evidence.quote: Hey Jon, glad I could help! Always here to cheer you on.

facts.text: Jon thanked Gina and expressed that he was glad she was on his side.

evidence.quote: Thanks! Glad that you are on my side.

facts.text: Jon sent an image of a drawing of a smiley face floating in the water.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of a drawing of a smiley face floating in the water]
